szoveg_eredeti:
Genie 4 is now available in Project Genie.

It brings native audio, real-time editing, plus a new agent to help you build interactive, virtual worlds.

We’re also introducing a community gallery to discover, remix, and share creations – alongside an updated Genie 3 in the model picker with up to 3-minute sessions. 

Rolling out to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. Start exploring  → https://goo.gle/492chwH
